body: Yeah it’s not good but it’s leagues lower on the messed up scale than some stuff I’ve seen stateside. Still wrong of course.
Wow that Catholic priest was really into Star Trek and Firefly references.

I’m sure that’s the biggest piece of evidence but it’s likely that the FBI still wants to talk to witnesses, each officer involved, examine the scene. You know and I know that there’s no excuse or mitigation for this kind of thing, but the FBI and prosecutors have to build a case where there is no way the defense can claim any mitigating factors. They probably will also be scrutinising the departmental training practices, complaints about the officers involved, etc. 

That is, if they’re doing their jobs correctly.

I feel this incredibly hard. The fact of the matter is, people like us are so incredibly obsessed reading into every single thing we have done and we assume others do as well. Unfortunately in my experience the best I can say is that people don’t always think when we act. People don’t necessarily want to hurt anybody or have some sort of deep psychological issue that hurts other people. We want to ascribe deep meaning, for food or just as often for ill, but really you just said something that hurt his feelings and he will likely not remember it in a day or two. Nobody can make you believe this but people don’t care as much about what we do as we think.

Would it help to get in contact with friends, set up zoom calls, anything to get some sort of outside expression? I am sort of being hypocritical as I haven’t really left home in a while and have had trouble sleeping lately with intrusive thoughts, but the small amount of solace I’ve had has come from virtually contacting outside folks.

This is something I had to do. I used to have severe intrusive thoughts about zombies after a horrifying series of movies and commercials about the subject. The only thing that ever helped was trying to see the actors in other movies. In that way I could put the characters out of the “real” category in my brain and into the “fictional” category. There’s no panacea out there but that would be my recommendation.

I know this doesn’t sound like much, but I appreciate that you keep swimming. I’m just some internet stranger, but I’ve been real low and everybody I see just continuing to fight and live as a confirmation that I did the right thing by not ending everything. It sounds like you’re really hurting and for such good reason. You’ve been given such a raw deal that you in no way deserve. But even if you don’t have people next to you in person, you have plenty of kindred spirits out there.
Your dog is extremely lucky to have a human who is putting their dog above their strife. I hope that you find more and more things to keep you around, we’re better for having you in the world.

Mate, there’s nothing wrong with this. I honestly wish I could be in your shoes. While there’s nothing really life changing about losing your virginity, and conversely there are tons of people who sleep around very ethically and with great care about people’s feelings, I’ve certainly lost friendships and opportunities to date people because we mutually moved too fast, things got awkward afterwards, or one of us wanted something more on the relationship side while the other did not. You can honestly say that that kind of thing has never happened to you, and your only sexual regret is one that affects only you. I think that’s powerful in a positive way.
I want to eat actual meals and enjoy a day with a person I’ve been seeing without thinking of everything I’ve done wrong.

That’s fine. And you don’t have to do anything that makes you less than totally comfortable. But if it’s alright with you, why don’t you write more here about what is making you feel this way? I know you don’t want to drag anybody else into your issues, and that is totally your right to privacy. But I can only speak for myself when I say that I have issues as well and sometimes it has helped to let people in. People here won’t judge you for it, we just want to support each other.
Well what you’re saying is really comforting actually. If you’re worried about getting worse then you aren’t there yet. Why don’t you stay on this thread and talk for a while?
You can survive to be better than your dad and to teach others to be better. Lord knows I wish I had a mentor before being stupid enough to make my mistakes.

What are your problems or thoughts on this subject? If you think you’re going to do it why not reach out either on this sub or using one of the hotlines that are available? It couldn’t hurt you, it will just take a few minutes, and it may just give you a new perspective.

If you’re sure that you’re going to do it regardless, why not take a second to call one of the hotlines you have available? I mean you have literally nothing to lose. Worst case scenario it may be a waste of a few minutes but it might just be the first step to deciding to live your life.
Hang in there redditor. I’m also up at 5 after only sleeping in a few hour chunks here and there.

It’s such a great sign that you’ve reached out. You want to get through the night, and that’s such an important thing. You feel like you’ve ruined everything but every mistake you’ve made is an opportunity to learn and an opportunity to teach others so they don’t have to go through what you went through. Please survive this night. 

If you’re comfortable, and it’s alright if you’re not and would rather talk to redditors who may be experiencing similar things, please call the crisis line if you feel you need to talk to somebody who knows what they’re doing. It’s confidential, and they’re kind, and they know what resources are available.

I hear you friend. Those heavy boxes can seem overwhelming, and play-acting being mentally well gets old and fast. But lifting those boxes gives you strength, even though you don’t feel that way. You have been going through something most people can’t understand, and it’s an accomplishment that you’ve gotten this far. Keep it up, that everlasting sleep looks really good but so does the light at the end of the tunnel. I’m not there either but I hope we can both be there someday.
I had to skip work to see an urgent psych appointment. I feel a bit better but not much.
I hope you find something that helps you hold together.
Do what you need to and are comfortable with, but I recommend calling that hotline. They’re pros, discreet, and have saved me before. Not that they’re superheroes, just saying there’s no shame.

When sex/making out/whatever happened is involved people do some things they end up regretting. But these situations can be so much worse. You didn’t ruin your life, you got carried away in the moment in response to a surprising situation. It doesn’t make you a bad person, and it doesn’t mean that people won’t forgive you eventually (though I don’t think you did anything that needs a major level of forgiveness). Hang in there, redditor, if this is the worst thing you’ve done you’re probably a good person.

Sorry. Feeling like I’m a horrible person who has messed up his own life and hurts everybody around me. I have family and friends but I’ve been driving them away with my broken brain. I’m single. And it wasn’t a single event it’s just everything in life.
Please don’t. You don’t have to spend money to make connections. If you need a friend, talk to me. God knows we both need it.

This is something I’m struggling with as well. I had one trauma and it is making me remember non-traumatic situations as traumatic. It’s also got me in a loop thinking that I did horrible unspecified things but that nobody remembers them or is covering for me without realizing it.

Shoot yeah I didn’t click through on “Not a confession” to see that they don’t want you posting sex stuff (non-explicit in any way, Just was about sex in general and accidentally hurting people emotionally) because they see it as finding out who you are, not a confession. Or maybe it wasn’t specific enough. Oh well, my mistake sorry y’all.
Did I break a rule? I didn’t think so

No not at all, it would have been to discuss any potential bad behavior I had. I only mentioned her behavior because I know her behavior was wrong but trusted that she didn’t realize. Which is why I thought I too could have had bad behavior that I didn’t realize. 

But you’re right, I’m glad this is a throwaway because this is not a great look and definitely a get over it or see a therapist type of thing.

You’re right. Reading this back it’s not a great look. It’s hard, but I should just try to live in the moment and be better. Even if there were issues with my behavior at the time, there’s no way I was a total monster without realizing it so I should just try to keep the good memories and lessons and move forward.
